contactQa.question: Projeye baslamak icin ne lazim?
contactQa.answer: Kisa hedef, marka/urun baglami, varsa Behance ya da referans linkleri, zaman araligi ve beklenen teslim formatlari yeterli.

contactQa.question: Teslimatlar nasil olur?
contactQa.answer: UI/UX ekranlari, marka gorselleri, poster/editorial tasarim, 3D web sahnesi, statik yayina hazir dosyalar veya frontend uygulama olarak planlanabilir.

contactQa.question: Behance ve cizimler birlikte kullanilir mi?
contactQa.answer: Evet. Behance gorselleri is kaniti, cizimler ise sanatsal arka plan olarak ayni portfolyo hikayesinin icinde birlikte gorunur.

contactQa.question: Zaman planini nasil netlestiriyoruz?
contactQa.answer: Brief formundaki oncelik, kapsam ve zaman bilgisine gore once hizli bir kapsam cevabi, sonra parcalanmis teslim plani cikarilir.

contactQa.question: 3D animasyon siteyi agirlastirir mi?
contactQa.answer: Sahne premium ve hareketli tutulur; ama DPR siniri, reduced-motion destegi ve fallback yuzeyleriyle performans korunur.

contactQa.question: Iletisim nereden ilerler?
contactQa.answer: En temiz yol email ve brief formu. Sosyal linkler kesif icin durur; proje netlestirme email uzerinden tutulur.

evolutionTracks.title: Behance gallery system
evolutionTracks.summary: Real Behance project visuals and iframe embed codes are now treated as first-class portfolio content.

evolutionTracks.title: Drawing archive expansion
evolutionTracks.summary: The drawing archive will evolve from a simple gallery into a curated visual research layer with stronger grouping and captions.

evolutionTracks.title: Cinematic motion pass
evolutionTracks.summary: 3D motion can grow through stronger scene transitions while keeping reduced-motion and mobile performance intact.

evolutionTracks.title: Contact and brief routing
evolutionTracks.summary: Brief capture remains local and email-first today, with a clean adapter path for database or mail delivery later.

evolutionTracks.title: Publishing readiness
evolutionTracks.summary: GitHub, Vercel and custom server publishing stay credential-aware so deployments do not require secrets in source.

qualityStandards.title: Cinematic visual impact
qualityStandards.metric: Behance + drawings visible before deep navigation
qualityStandards.summary: The portfolio should immediately show real work, drawing material and atmospheric depth without becoming noisy.

qualityStandards.title: Performance discipline
qualityStandards.metric: Build passes, mobile-safe 3D, lazy external media
qualityStandards.summary: 3D and iframe embeds are allowed, but they must be lazy, bounded and supported by simpler fallback surfaces.

qualityStandards.title: Accessible motion and structure
qualityStandards.metric: Semantic sections, reduced-motion support, keyboard paths
qualityStandards.summary: The cinematic layer should never block reading, navigation, forms or assistive technologies.

qualityStandards.title: Publish safety
qualityStandards.metric: No secrets in source, auth checked before push/deploy
qualityStandards.summary: Deployment targets remain explicit and credential-aware, with rollback through static fallback and scoped commits.
